FULL TEXT:
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF GUEST FACULTY (01)
Applications are invited for the appointment of one (01) Guest Faculty in the Centre for Social Work, Panjab
University, Chandigarh, purely on a temporary basis for the Odd Semester of the Academic Session 2026–27.
Subject/Specialization: Master of Social Work No. of Post: 01
The applicants are required to fill the prescribed application form for the post of Assistant Professor available
on the Panjab University website: https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-forms.php. The duly filled application form,
along with two sets of self-attested copies of all testimonials/certificates and two recent passport-size
photographs, must be submitted to the office of the undersigned.
Essential Qualifications:
i. Master's Degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever the grading system is
followed) in Social Work from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign
University.
A relaxation of 5% shall be allowed at the Master's level for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes
(SC)/Scheduled Tribes (ST)/Backward Classes (BC)/Persons with Disabilities (PwD), as per UGC/Panjab
University norms.
ii. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test
(NET) conducted by the UGC/CSIR or a similar test accredited by the UGC, such as SLET/SET, or must have
been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards
and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016, and amendments thereto.
Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to 11 July 2009 shall be governed by the then existing
UGC Regulations/University Ordinances and shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject
to fulfillment of the conditions prescribed by the UGC, duly certified by the Registrar/Dean (Academic Affairs).
Desirable Experience: Experience of teaching Postgraduate classes of Master of Social Work.
Honorarium: ₹1,500/- (Rupees One Thousand Five Hundred only) per lecture, subject to a maximum ceiling
of ₹50,000/- per month, as per Panjab University norms.
The selected candidate shall furnish an undertaking that he/she is not drawing any fellowship, stipend, or
financial assistance from any agency during the period of engagement as Guest Faculty.
Last Date for Submission of Applications: The applications must reach the office of the undersigned on or
before 10th August 2026 up to 3:00 p.m.
Interview: Eligible candidates shall appear for the interview in person before the Selection Committee on:
Date: 11th August 2026 (Tuesday)
Reporting Time: 2:30 p.m.
Venue: Office of the Chairperson, Centre for Social Work, New Emerging Areas Building, Panjab University,
Chandigarh–160014.
Notes:
1. Original documents along with self-attested photocopies shall be verified at the time of the interview.
2. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
3. The selected Guest Faculty shall perform teaching duties and participate in all other academic and
departmental activities assigned by the Centre from time to time.
Chairperson
Centre for Social Work
Panjab University
Chandigarh
